title: Raku Firing - Second Saturdays
summary: Drop-off raku firing on the second Saturday of each month. Bring your own bisque-fired pieces; each reservation includes a 4x4x6" kiln spot. You can watch the firing or leave it with them.
cost_text: Space reserved per 4x4x6" spot; optional glaze application $7
evidence_sentence: The raku firing page states 'Second Saturdays' as the firing date for traditional raku firing outdoors.
